body:
Here’s the Q:

 I am a pastor and I am just now reading some books from Brian. I have a question: Is there any emerging Church or Association in Spain? Could I get in contact with someone able to advise me in the task of developing a church here in Spain? Thank you so much.

 Here’s the R:

 This will be posted over at my Facebook page. If there are any churches or networks in Spain, I hope they’ll post a reply there so you can find each other. I’d love to hear about this too!
